programmes.d: Detectives chase "Fufu," a villain who stole Escobar's stash from the LAPD. Hijinks ensue as they swap identities to protect a witness.
The love is hot when Breanna meets coffee shop owner Malcom, but his fear of commitment might put it on ice.
Struggling with his finances working as a mechanic, CrimMane chooses the dope track as his side hustle, until a client offers him a dangerous proposition.
After the unarmed shooting of William King, a college bound black teen, by two white officers, a city is on fire as it seeks justice in these times of racial division.
A group of five fraternity brothers reunite after a decade apart, only to be haunted by a deadly secret from their past.

Four women embark on a journey of self-discovery and resilience, bound by the unbreakable bonds of friendship. Through tears and laughter, heartache and triumph, they become closer while helping each other through some tough situations.
Dr. Athena Hart thought she had seen every kind of broken soul-until Lucas Morningstar walked into her office. What begins as therapy quickly twists into a deadly game of obsession and revenge.

Happily married Jessica has accepted that she is going to die from a terminal illness, and isn't afraid of death. Her real fear however, is her husband Reginald falling back in love with his ex Rebecca, and stealing the life she built.
Brandon is a rising star in the podcast world. When he receives an on-air call from Paulette, a local barista, he soon learns that success comes at a price.

Three women face financial woes and look to dealing for local drug lord Zeus. Jealousy, intimidation, and greed set in, when Zeus sees that they are selling and pushing faster than he ever could and suspects they are cutting in on him.

Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival; after moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club and quickly rises to the top.
